# 🚀 Release v0.4.11

## Note: I won't build Full version anymore because it's now officially released [here](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/releases).

AltStore/SideStore source:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luqmanfadlli/NuvioMobile-iOS/main/NuvioEnhanced.json
```

## Upstream changelog:
- feat(details): add tappable expandable descriptions @tapframe
- fix: Simkl anime type classification and landscape poster aspect ratio (#1786) @skoruppa
- fix(details): reset episode position when switching seasons @tapframe
- fix(search): persist discover catalog selection @tapframe
- fix(ios): correct launch screen configuration @tapframe
- fix(player): make subtitle aggregation multiplatform @tapframe
- Respect corner radius for trailers and episodes (#1784) @skoruppa
- i18n(el): add missing Greek translations (#1783) @nosvasedis
- fix(catalog): preserve scroll position after details @tapframe
- fix: address mobile crash clusters (NUVIO-MOBILE-4 NUVIO-MOBILE-QK NUVIO-MOBILE-FZ) @tapframe
- Latest strings added to the Bulgarian translation (#1779) @viiktr
- fix: per-episode rating from addon metadata is never parsed (#1776) @6ip
- feat(player): port sidecar addon subtitles, fix selection state, and parallelize fetching (#1705) @halibiram

## Enhanced changelog:
- All changes from the upstream
- perf(ios): arm PiP capture only when a frame is actually wanted @luqmanfadlli 
- fix(profile): stop edit screen from getting stuck and fix return navigation @albertovinaroz

---
> **💡 Note**
Android APKs are now split by architecture (ABI) and compiled as signed release builds (no longer debug versions), resulting in a much snappier and more responsive experience.
